name: investment-crossover-point-calculator
description: A privacy-friendly browser calculator for investment growth crossover and financial independence milestones.

paragraphs: Investment Crossover Point Calculator is a free, privacy-friendly, browser-based financial planning tool that helps users explore two different investment milestones that are often described with the same phrase. The first milestone is the growth crossover point, when projected annual investment growth becomes equal to or greater than the amount contributed during that year. The second milestone is the financial independence crossover point, when projected annual portfolio spending, based on a selected planning withdrawal rate, becomes equal to or greater than inflation-adjusted annual…

The project separates these milestones because they answer different questions. Growth crossover helps users understand when compounding may become a larger annual contributor than new savings. Financial independence crossover helps users estimate when a portfolio may support a chosen level of annual spending. A later growth crossover does not automatically mean weaker financial progress. Higher contributions can raise the crossover threshold while also building a larger portfolio and bringing the financial independence milestone closer.

This website is designed as a lightweight static application. It requires no account, no database, no server-side calculation, and no build process. All calculations run locally in the browser. The project can be hosted directly on GitHub Pages or any standard static web server.
